name: robots/pauldanielml__mujoco_rl_ur5
title: MuJoCo UR5 + gripper Grasper-v0 (simulation)
intro: MuJoCo UR5 + gripper Grasper-v0 (simulation), adapted from pauldanielml/mujoco_rl_ur5. It reads `observation`, `reward`, `terminated`, `truncated` and 4 more; runs `step`, `reset` and `seed`. `step`: advance the simulated world by a bounded number of fixed timesteps, optionally applying an action for each step, and return the resulting observation and terminal flags. A simulator: the market serves it with a stand-in that needs no simulator install.
